transcript.zh_text: 那个方向20英里外有个镇子。

transcript.en_text: First off, I'd like to congratulate President Underwood for his victory here tonight.
transcript.zh_text: 首先，我想祝贺安德伍德总统今晚在这里取得的胜利。

transcript.en_text: It was a tight race and he came out on top.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一场激烈的竞争，他脱颖而出。

transcript.en_text: Let's not be sore losers here.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不要在这里做输不起的人。

transcript.en_text: Because the truth is, we haven't lost.
transcript.zh_text: 因为事实是，我们没有输。

transcript.en_text: I want to thank all the staff and volunteers who worked so hard over the past several months.
transcript.zh_text: 我要感谢所有在过去几个月里辛勤工作的员工和志愿者。

transcript.en_text: I want to try Claire one more time.
transcript.zh_text: 我想再试着联系克莱尔一次。

transcript.en_text: That's three hours from now, even if she left this minute.
transcript.zh_text: 那距离现在还有三小时，即使她现在马上出发。

transcript.en_text: We don't want to squander primetime.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不想浪费黄金时段。

transcript.en_text: A speech at one in the morning, we lose major viewership.
transcript.zh_text: 凌晨一点的演讲，我们会失去大量观众。

transcript.en_text: My children and my dear husband...
transcript.zh_text: 我的孩子们和我亲爱的丈夫...

transcript.en_text: How do you want to handle the stage if she's not on it?
transcript.zh_text: 如果她不在台上，你打算如何应对舞台？
嗯，爱荷华州已经表态了。

transcript.en_text: And they have spoken so loud, that I don't even need a microphone.
transcript.zh_text: 他们表态的声音如此响亮，我甚至都不需要麦克风了。

transcript.en_text: Listen, I wanted to come down here to our campaign headquarters in Des Moines, not go to some fancy hotel ballroom like you know who, and say to all of you who worked day in and day out, on our behalf for this campaign, in every corner of this state...
transcript.zh_text: 听着，我之所以想来咱们在得梅因的竞选总部，而不是去某个你知道是谁去过的豪华酒店宴会厅，是想对所有为了这次竞选，为了我们，在这个州的每个角落里日复一日地辛勤工作的人说...

transcript.en_text: It's because of you that we brought it home tonight!
transcript.zh_text: 正是因为你们，我们今晚才取得了胜利！

transcript.en_text: Now, I know you're all wondering where Claire is.
transcript.zh_text: 好了，我知道你们都在想克莱尔在哪儿。

transcript.en_text: Some of you may know she's been a little under the weather.
transcript.zh_text: 你们可能有些人知道她有点不舒服。

transcript.en_text: She doesn't understand these Iowa winters you have.
transcript.zh_text: 她不习惯爱荷华的冬天。

transcript.en_text: But she's on the mend and I'm flying to Washington tonight, so that tomorrow she and I can get on a plane and fly to New Hampshire, where we are gonna win there, too!
transcript.zh_text: 但她正在康复中，我今晚要飞往华盛顿，这样明天她和我就可以乘飞机去新罕布什尔州，我们也会在那里获胜！

transcript.en_text: They told me you were down here.
I just wanted to come somewhere to think.
transcript.zh_text: 我只是想找个地方好好想想。
好吧，我希望你已经想好了。

transcript.en_text: And that whatever was clouding your mind is gone.
transcript.zh_text: 希望你心里那些烦恼已经消散了。

transcript.en_text: Because I just had to give a victory speech... alone.
transcript.zh_text: 因为我刚刚不得不独自发表了胜利演讲。

transcript.en_text: And one way or another, I need you on that plane with me tomorrow.
transcript.zh_text: 不管怎样，我明天都需要你和我一起上那架飞机。

transcript.en_text: It felt wrong to throw it out, for some reason.
transcript.zh_text: 不知道为什么，我感觉把它扔掉是错的。

transcript.en_text: When I said we were lying, what I meant was...
transcript.zh_text: 当我说我们在撒谎时，我的意思是……

transcript.en_text: For all these years, I thought we were on this path together.
transcript.zh_text: 这么多年来，我一直以为我们是在一起走的。

transcript.en_text: But it's not what I thought it would be.
transcript.zh_text: 但这和我想象的不一样。

transcript.en_text: What I convinced myself it would be, like what Thomas wrote.
transcript.zh_text: 我说服自己会是那样，就像托马斯写的那样。

transcript.en_text: - We're two equal parts. - We are.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们是平等的两部分。- 是的。
我们共同赢得了这一切。

transcript.en_text: I said that to your face the first day I walked in here as president.
transcript.zh_text: 我以总统身份上任第一天，就当着你的面说了。

transcript.en_text: I have not made a single major decision without asking your opinion first.
transcript.zh_text: 我从未在没有先征求你意见的情况下做出任何重大决定。

transcript.en_text: Anything that I want, like the UN...
transcript.zh_text: 任何我想要的东西，比如联合国……
这让我很不舒服，弗朗西斯。

transcript.en_text: Why, because you had to resign?
transcript.zh_text: 为什么？因为你不得不辞职吗？

transcript.en_text: No, because I had to ask for your help in the first place.
transcript.zh_text: 不，因为我一开始就不得不寻求你的帮助。

transcript.en_text: That I couldn't get the confirmation on my own.
And what is wrong with asking for my help when you need it?
transcript.zh_text: 你需要的时候寻求我的帮助有什么问题？

transcript.en_text: The fact that I need it.
I don't recognize myself when I look in the mirror.
transcript.zh_text: 当我照镜子时，我都不认识自己了。

transcript.en_text: I do things... like I did in the hotel in Iowa.
transcript.zh_text: 我做的事情...就像我在爱荷华州的酒店里做的那样。

transcript.en_text: I can't even talk with you about it.
transcript.zh_text: 我甚至无法和你谈论这件事。

transcript.en_text: Instead you want me to slap you around like some animal.
transcript.zh_text: 相反，你却想让我像对待动物一样扇你耳光。

transcript.en_text: That's what we are when we strip everything away.
transcript.zh_text: 当我们抛开一切时，我们就是那样。

transcript.en_text: - That I can understand! - It was deranged, begging me to take you like that.
transcript.zh_text: - 那我能理解！ - 那是精神错乱的，你乞求我那样对待你。

transcript.en_text: And you couldn't even give that to me.
transcript.zh_text: 而你甚至连那都不能给我。

transcript.en_text: If you wanted a husband who proved his manhood to you that way, you should've stayed back in Dallas with your mother and married the prom king.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你想要一个以那种方式向你证明他男子气概的丈夫，那你当初就该待在达拉斯和你母亲在一起，嫁给舞会之王。

transcript.en_text: At least I would've known where I stood.
transcript.zh_text: 至少我那时会知道我的立场。

transcript.en_text: No, you can't have it both ways.
You want an equal partner when it suits you?
transcript.zh_text: 当你觉得方便时，你想要一个平等的伴侣？

transcript.en_text: You want a man to take charge when it suits you?
transcript.zh_text: 当你觉得方便时，你想要一个男人来做主？

transcript.en_text: And I'm supposed to what, just divine when you want which?
transcript.zh_text: 而我呢，就应该去猜测你何时想要哪个吗？

transcript.en_text: - I'm not being selfish. - You are.
transcript.zh_text: - 我没有自私。 - 你就是。

transcript.en_text: We're in the middle of an election, and look at us.
transcript.zh_text: 我们正处于选举中，看看我们现在这样子。

transcript.en_text: We used to make each other stronger.
transcript.zh_text: 我们曾经让彼此更强大。

transcript.en_text: At least I thought so, but that was a lie.
transcript.zh_text: 至少我是这么认为的，但那是个谎言。
我们一直在让你变得更强大。

transcript.en_text: And now I'm just weak and small, and I can't stand that feeling any longer.
transcript.zh_text: 而现在我只是虚弱渺小，我再也无法忍受那种感觉了。
他妈的替代方案是什么？

transcript.en_text: Please, Claire, tell me, because I don't understand.
transcript.zh_text: 求你了，克莱尔，告诉我，因为我不明白。

transcript.en_text: All I am hearing is, it's not enough.
transcript.zh_text: 我听到的只是，这还不够。

transcript.en_text: That the White House is not enough.
That being First Lady is not enough.
When we lose... because of you...
transcript.zh_text: 当我们输了... 都因为你...
我们只会沦为过气人物。

transcript.en_text: And you want to amount to something?
Well, here is the brutal fucking truth.
transcript.zh_text: 好，这就是残酷的狗屁真相。

transcript.en_text: And you can hate me, you can be disgusted, you can feel whatever it is you wanna feel because frankly, I'm beyond caring.
transcript.zh_text: 你可以恨我，你可以感到厌恶，你可以想感受什么就感受什么，因为说实话，我根本不在乎了。

transcript.en_text: But without me, you are nothing.
transcript.zh_text: 但没有我，你什么也不是。
这间办公室只有一把椅子。

transcript.en_text: And you have always known that from the very beginning.
transcript.zh_text: 而你从一开始就一直知道这一点。

transcript.en_text: And if you now can't stomach that, well, then I'm a fool for having married you in the first place.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你现在无法忍受这一点，那我当初嫁给你真是个傻瓜。

transcript.en_text: But I don't have time to be a fool.
I have to run this country and win a nomination.
transcript.zh_text: 我必须治理这个国家并赢得提名。

transcript.en_text: Doug is out there doing his job.
transcript.zh_text: 道格在那边做他的工作。

transcript.en_text: And it's time now for you to do yours.
You want me to take charge?
You will get on that plane tomorrow.
You will come to New Hampshire.
You will smile and shake hands and kiss babies.
transcript.zh_text: 你将面带微笑，握手，亲吻婴儿。

transcript.en_text: And you will stand with me on a stage.
transcript.zh_text: 你将和我一起站在舞台上。

transcript.en_text: And you will be the First Lady!
I don't give a damn if you vomit on your own time.
transcript.zh_text: 我才不管你什么时候吐呢。

transcript.en_text: You're scheduled to depart in 20 minutes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，您定于20分钟后启程。

transcript.en_text: Check in with the First Lady, make sure she's ready.
transcript.zh_text: 去第一夫人那儿报个到，确认她准备好了。

transcript.en_text: Ma'am, the president wanted me to check and see if you're ready.
transcript.zh_text: 夫人，总统让我来看看您是否准备好了。

transcript.en_text: I'm not going to New Hampshire.
I'll see you in the car.
